List orgs, workspaces and documents; manage workspaces

Source: R/workspaces.R
grist_orgs.Rd

Orgs are the team sites (or personal areas) you can access. Each org has workspaces, and each workspace holds documents.

  • grist_orgs() lists the orgs you can access.

  • grist_workspaces() lists the workspaces in an org.

  • grist_docs() lists the documents in an org, with their workspace.

  • grist_workspace_create() creates a workspace.

  • grist_workspace_delete() and grist_workspace_restore() move a workspace to the trash or delete it permanently, and restore it. As with grist_doc_delete(), deleting asks for confirmation.

Usage

grist_orgs(server = NULL, options = NULL)

grist_workspaces(org = "current", server = NULL, options = NULL)

grist_docs(org = "current", server = NULL, options = NULL)

grist_workspace_create(name, org = "current", server = NULL, options = NULL)

grist_workspace_delete(
  workspace,
  mode = c("trash", "permanent"),
  ask = NULL,
  server = NULL,
  options = NULL
)

grist_workspace_restore(workspace, server = NULL, options = NULL)

Arguments

server

URL of the Grist server, such as "https://docs.getgrist.com" or "https://myteam.getgrist.com". For a self-hosted server, include the team path if needed, e.g. "http://localhost:8484/o/docs". Defaults to the server in doc if doc is a URL, then the GRIST_SERVER environment variable, then "https://docs.getgrist.com".

options

A grist_request_options() object. If NULL, the default from getOption("gristmillr.request_options") or grist_request_options() is used.

org

An org ID or domain. "current" is the org that matches the server URL. If the server has no current org (as with Grist Desktop) and you can access exactly one org, that org is used. Otherwise, set org to a value from grist_orgs()$id.

name

Document name.

workspace

A workspace ID.

mode

"trash" moves the document to the trash, where it can be restored with grist_doc_restore(). "permanent" deletes it for good.

ask

Whether to prompt before running. NULL (the default) and TRUE prompt in an interactive session and error in a script. FALSE skips the prompt.

Value

A data frame for the listing functions. grist_workspace_create() returns the new workspace ID invisibly. grist_workspace_delete() and grist_workspace_restore() return the workspace ID invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) {
grist_orgs()
grist_workspaces()
grist_docs()
id <- grist_workspace_create(name = "Pets")
grist_workspace_delete(id, ask = FALSE)
}
